A rainy-day date near Hapjeong and Sangsu: a cosy stone-oven pizza restaurant for two

On a rainy day, you want a date somewhere warm where you can talk at an easy pace. Hongdae Hwaduk Pizza (홍대화덕피자) in Hapjeong and Sangsu serves stone-oven pizza and pasta in a dining room with warm lighting, wooden tables and string lights. It is about five minutes on foot from Hapjeong or Sangsu Station.

A cosy restaurant for a rainy-day date

The dining room is decorated with warm lighting, wooden tables, brick arches and string lights. In Naver visitor review keywords, more than 900 reviewers chose 'great interior' and more than 800 chose 'cosy' (as of November 2026). On a rainy evening, it is a good place to sit face to face and talk.

A rainy evening at the restaurant

On a rainy evening, the lights at the entrance glow softly across the wet street. Step inside and you will find wooden tables under warm lighting. While your pizza bakes in the oven, it is an evening made for slow conversation.

Dishes to share on a rainy day

Share a stone-oven pizza with a warm pasta. A half-and-half pizza lets you choose two flavours. Try Quattro Formaggi for cheese or Quattro Stagioni for a variety of toppings, and add Gamberi Crema, a spicy shrimp cream pasta with cheese melted in the oven, or a shrimp and arugula oil pasta. These are suggestions, not a fixed set or an order quantity for two. Check the latest menu and prices on Naver Place.

Where to meet

Meet at Hapjeong Station Exit 6 or Sangsu Station Exit 1; each is about a five-minute walk. From Hongik University Station it is about fifteen minutes on foot.

Booking and questions

Open Naver Place, select its reservation button and check whether a table for two is available at your preferred date and time. For a first date, contact the restaurant about seating requests beforehand (+82-507-1349-2285). The address is 5 Dongmak-ro 7-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, ground floor.
